Retrieve WCPFC logbook effort data

get_logbook_effort.Rd

Queries logbook catch-and-effort tables for one or more gear types and returns total effort (as determined by gear) summarised by flag, year, species and gear.

Usage

get_logbook_effort(
  in_wcpfc = TRUE,
  year = NULL,
  flag = NULL,
  gear = c("P", "S", "L", "T"),
  species = NULL,
  exclude_flag = NULL,
  exclude_species = NULL,
  show_sql = FALSE
)

Arguments

in_wcpfc

Optional filter passed to .sql_filter() restricting records to those inside (or outside) the WCPFC Convention Area.

year

Optional numeric vector of years to filter by.

flag

Optional character vector of flag codes to filter by.

gear

Character vector of gear codes to query. One or more of "P" (purse seine), "S" (pole-and-line), "L" (longline), or "T" (troll). Defaults to all four.

species

Optional character vector of species codes to filter by.

Value

A tibble with one row per flag/year/species/gear combination, containing:

FLAG_CODE

Flag code.

YY

Year.

SP_CODE

Species code.

The effort column(s) are determined by the gear_code provided

GEAR_CODE

Gear code ("P", "S", "L", or "T").

Details

For each requested gear, catch is pulled by joining log.trips_* -> log.sets_* -> log.catch_* (table suffix set by gear_suffix), restricted to vessel instances active over the trip period (via ref.vessel_instances). Longline ("L") catch is queried and summed in kilograms (sp_kg, including discards) since it is recorded at that resolution; all other gears are summed directly in tonnes (sp_mt). After all gears are queried and row-bound, any sp_kg totals are converted to tonnes and coalesced into sp_mt, and the now-redundant sp_kg column is dropped.

Note

convert_catch_to_mt() is defined inside the function but is not currently called anywhere in the body — the kg-to-tonnes conversion for longline catch is instead handled directly in the final dplyr::mutate() step. Left in place here as-is; flag for removal or wiring in if that was the intent.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# All gears, all flags/species/years
get_logbook_catch()

# Purse seine and longline catch for one flag, 2020-2023
get_logbook_catch(flag = "FJ", gear = c("P", "L"), year = 2020:2023)
} # }
